description: The agent must execute a 7-step workflow using the GTM CLI: (1) `add-contact 'Jordan Mehta' 'jordan.mehta@vertexsystems.io' --company 'Vertex Systems' --role 'Head of Infrastructure'` to register the contact. (2) `add-opp 'Vertex Systems' --contact <id> --description '...' --priority 5` to create the opportunity linked to the new contact. (3) `move-stage <opp_id> evaluation` — THE PROPRIETARY TRAP: the agent must use the exact stage name 'evaluation' (not 'evaluating', 'trial', 'active', or 'demo'); this is a bespoke enum defined in the skill. (4) `log '...' --opp <opp_id>` to record the discovery call note. (5) `remind 'Send custom pricing proposal and ROI analysis' --opp <opp_id> --date 2024-03-01` with the exact date format. (6) `add-keyword 'wasm-compute' --category domain --weight 2.5` — must use --category and --weight flags with correct values; an agent without the SKILL.md won't know these flags exist. (7) `crawl` (no source restriction to get all 3 sources), then enumerate all unprocessed signal IDs via `signals` and call `process-signal <id>` for each one — including the 2 pre-seeded signals AND the newly crawled ones. The eval checks the SQLite database directly for all 7 outcomes.
